selected_by: ConvNeXt-Tiny (trained on Google Colab T4) fine-tuned on 180 target-domain calibration images (30% of test patients) for 2 epochs; backbone, epochs and threshold chosen by 3-fold patient-level CV on those images (OOF accuracy 95.6%); metrics reported on the untouched 70% holdout (444 images). Weights stored in fp16.
